title: Who is she talking to? · What is it like? (вопросы 3)

exercises.instruction: Вы хотите узнать недостающую информацию (XXXXX). Напишите вопросы с who или what.

items.prompt: I went to the cinema with XXXXX.
answers: Who did you go to the cinema with?

items.prompt: I gave the money to XXXXX.
answers: Who did you give the money to?

items.prompt: The book was written by XXXXX.
answers: Who was the book written by?

exercises.instruction: Напишите вопросы о людях, изображённых на картинках. Используйте глагол из рамки + предлог:

answers: Which restaurant is he going to?
Which bus are they waiting for?
Which hotel did you stay at?

items.prompt: Jack plays for a football team.
answers: Which football team does he play for?
Which team does he play for?

items.prompt: I went to school in this town.
answers: Which school did you go to?

exercises.instruction: Вы хотите узнать о другой стране. Задайте вопросы знакомому, который там побывал. Используйте What is/are ... like?
Задайте вопросы, используя What was/were ... like?

items.prompt: Your friend has just come back from holiday. Ask about the weather.
Your friend has just come back from the cinema. Ask about the film.
Your friend has just finished an English course. Ask about the lessons.
Your friend has just come back from holiday. Ask about the hotel.

exercises.instruction:
Переведите предложения на английский язык. [говорить о = talk about
начальник = manager]

answers: What street is your house in?
What street is your house on?
Which street is your house in?
Which street is your house on?

items.prompt: С кем Том идёт на вечеринку?
answers: Who is Tom going to the party with?
What train are you waiting for?
Which train are you waiting for?
What was the weather like in Rome?
What music do you usually listen to?
